item.subject: science
item.stem: At dinner, Meena watches her little brother Aarav eat his chapati. He chews it well before swallowing. Meena explains that the teeth, saliva and tongue work together so that the food is ready to pass into the food pipe. What is the main reason chewing, saliva and the tongue are needed before swallowing?

options.A: They add all the nutrients to the food before it is swallowed.
options.B: They kill all the germs in the food inside the mouth.
options.C: They soften and moisten the food and mix it with saliva so it can be swallowed easily.
options.D: They move the food directly from the mouth into the stomach.
